tide.config.js

info

New to Tide? Start with the first tide walkthrough.

Overview​

tide.config.js sits beside your package.json and tells createTide which harbor to watch.

tide.config.js
export default {
  harbor: 'west-pier',
};

Required fields​

harbor​

  • Type: string

Name of the harbor to watch. Shown in logs and in the gauge label.

tide.config.js
export default {
  harbor: 'west-pier',
};

endpoint​

  • Type: string

Socket the gauge reports to. This field works together with the harbor field.

tide.config.js
export default {
  endpoint: 'wss://tide.acme.example',
};

Optional fields​

NameTypeDefaultDescription
ratenumber250Milliseconds between two calls to Tide.ebb().
mode'gentle' | 'spring''gentle'When 'spring', the gauge drains in one step.
